notes.title: Update is live!
notes.notes:
Hello! The announced update has been released and it affects both the full game and the demo. Much of the geometry of the existing levels has been altered and a lot of details were added. 
As anticipated, this is the last scheduled update for the current content. For now on I’ll focus my efforts to create new levels and to fix bugs.

notes.title: Weekly update.
notes.notes:
This week was partially spent polishing various aspects of the game but most prominently was used to prepare the tools used for the creation of the levels for the last scheduled update of the current content. Following the feedback received from the players, I decided to enhance the number of details and specificity of each area of the current levels. This won’t be fast as the 12 levels of the game are… quite big and updating each level is quite a delicate and long task, but I’m almost halfway through it! notes.title: Visual effect improvements, powerup balancing , autosave, UI bugfix map changes.
notes.notes:
Bug Fixing:
UI elements with wrong behaviour
Modified behaviour of global and local map (minor change)
A couple of invisible walls created to prevent the player from falling were not working as expected
Rework of the UI of the load screen, to make it more responsive.
Fixed scrolling issue in the codex section


Balancing
The SMG has been reworked to differentiate its use. It now longer shoots a perfect row of bullets but a little deviation is assigned to each bullet. Un-upgraded number of bullets has been increased to 3, lowering the damage of each bullet.
The SMG now has a different powerup. The headshot multiplier was replaced by a powerup that makes the recoil predictable and compensable with mouse aim. 
Minor adjustment to enemies health. 


Map changes:
A couple of locations were reworked to be more evocative. These changes will continue in future updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097962/44ff8061d0f23eaba862844d528ad9c2a73cb871.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097962/dd4ec4cfa492343df9b191927ab705b43fd9860a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097962/9a7450ec903bca5d759fa9a8652a7fcfe8a13900.jpg[/img]
Autosave: 
Autosave is now a thing in Palladium. Each save point will activate only once and will be easily spotted through all saved games. 


Visual improvements. 
Post processing and colour balancing has been completely reworked with this update. 
Lights were modified and recalculated in a few instances. 
Added visual effects for light elements. 
Enemies can now be gibbed only partially, leaving mutilated remains. 
Also all enemies have dedicated gibs and animations for various parts of the body.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097962/1fc48f455a534df0b0768c4cb37e3d934158696c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097962/42dac3a80a2e40e22900d98e8186f60adca0144d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097962/9e841af0e3bee48f86c3c90e22faf637f7b1473a.jpg[/img]

Bunny hopping has been introduced to help traverse areas previously explored and to give a significant edge to the player over the enemies. 


Most of the messages in the tutorial level have been rephrased to make them more clear.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: The last update was important and arrived pretty fast. For this reason some hotfixes are necessary.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix
notes.notes:
A small issue related to animations on lower-end PCs has been fixed. The update is very light, as such I don't feel guilty to make an update for this issue. 

Don't forget to report any issue or bug or unexpected behaviour through Steam or the official Discord!

notes.title: Graphical update of NPC is complete!
notes.notes:
Sprites are gone. Almost. The representation of enemies is now designed to keep the feeling of the retro games, but with smoother animations for better readability of the situation and of the particular state of each enemy. Also, is now much easier to modify enemies to correct and improve the gameplay, giving to the player colour and shape clues to suggest the behaviour of each enemy. Moreover, it is now easier to modify them and correct… unwise colour choices. 
The switch to models also allowed me to make various variants of the NPC types with a reasonable effort.
Finally, dismemberment is now a possibility and not only a dream and it MAY be included in future builds.
